title: Agent Identity & Delegation Attestation (AIDA)
description: Canonical JSON Schema for the Agent Identity & Delegation Attestation. Defines identity documents, capability grants, and attestation receipts for AI agents.

AidaUri.description: An AIDA agent identifier: aida:<base58-encoded-ed25519-public-key>. The URI scheme is 'aida'. The authority is a base58-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key.

Ed25519VerificationKey.description: An Ed25519 public key for cryptographic verification.

publicKeyBase58.description: Base58-encoded 32-byte Ed25519 public key. The same value appears in the AidaUri.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the signature was created.

proofValue.description: Base58-encoded Ed25519 signature over the canonicalized document.

verificationMethod.description: URI identifying the public key used for verification. Typically an AidaUri or a DNS-based key URL.

AidaEndpoint.description: A service endpoint where the agent can be reached. References the AID discovery model.

protocol.description: The protocol spoken at this endpoint. References AID's protocol negotiation model.

metadata.description: Optional protocol-specific metadata (e.g., MCP server name, OpenAPI spec URL).

SoulHash.description: A deterministic integrity fingerprint of the agent's identity files. Computed as SHA-256 of sorted file hashes. Detects soul-rewriting attacks.

HashLink.description: A SHA-256 hash linking to the previous item in a chain. Used in attestation receipt chains and delegation chains.

Controller.description: The human or organizational entity that controls this agent identity. At least one binding is required.

did.description: W3C Decentralized Identifier of the controller.

dns.description: DNS domain owned by the controller. Enables DNS-based verification.

oauth.description: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC issuer URL for delegated identity verification.

maxCount.description: Maximum number of times this capability can be exercised.

timeWindow.description: ISO 8601 duration. The capability is only valid within this time window from issuance.

maxValue.description: Maximum monetary value (in the asset's smallest unit, e.g., USDC wei) for payment-gated capabilities.

allowedDomains.description: List of domains this capability is restricted to.

ipAllowlist.description: IPv4 addresses allowed to exercise this capability.

requireConsent.description: If true, human consent is required via HITL before each exercise of this capability.

Capability.description: A single delegated capability — an action the subject is authorized to perform on a resource.

resource.description: URI template identifying the resource scope (e.g., 'files:/home/alice/*', 'api:github.com/repos/*').

riskLevel.description: The inherent risk level of this capability. Drives consent routing decisions.

VerificationProfile.description: How to verify an AIDA document. Multiple profiles can be specified; at least one must succeed.

local.description: Local Ed25519 signature verification. No external dependencies.

dns.description: DNS-based verification via _aida TXT record and DNSSEC. References AID discovery.

ledger.description: On-chain verification. Blockchain-agnostic — specify the chain and contract.

zk.description: Zero-knowledge verification. The verifier receives a ZK proof without seeing the underlying data.

AidaIdentityDocument.description: Layer 1: An AIDA Identity Document. The root of trust for an agent identity. Self-signed by the agent's Ed25519 key.

controller.description: The human or organization that controls this agent.

soulHash.description: Integrity fingerprint of the agent's identity files (SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, system prompt, tool definitions). Recomputed on identity refresh.

endpoints.description: Service endpoints where this agent can be reached.

capabilities.description: Self-declared high-level capabilities (e.g., 'code-generation', 'file-management', 'web-search'). Not authoritative — capability grants are.

verification.description: Supported verification profiles. At least one required.

updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last document update.

expires.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this document expires. If omitted, the document does not expire.

proof.description: Self-signature proving possession of the private key corresponding to publicKey.

AidaCapabilityGrant.description: Layer 2: An AIDA Capability Grant. Delegates specific capabilities from an issuer to a subject agent. Supports chaining (A→B→C).

id.description: Unique identifier for this grant (URN or URL).

issuer.description: The agent (or controller) granting the capabilities.

delegationChain.description: Ordered chain of prior grants. The first entry is the root grant from a controller to the first agent. Enables A→B→C delegation chains.

previousGrant.description: Hash link to the previous grant in the chain. Null for the root grant.

policyUri.description: Optional URI to a policy document that governs this grant (e.g., an OPA Rego policy).

issuedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this grant was issued.

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this grant expires. If omitted, the grant does not expire.

revocationUri.description: URI where revocation status can be checked (e.g., OCSP-style endpoint or on-chain contract).

proof.description: Issuer's signature over the grant document.

AidaAction.description: An action performed by an agent that is recorded in an attestation receipt.

type.description: The type of action being attested.

tool.description: For tool_call actions: the tool name (e.g., 'read_file', 'terminal', 'browser_navigate').

toolParameters.description: For tool_call actions: the tool parameters (may be redacted for privacy).

toolResult.description: For tool_call actions: the tool result summary (may be redacted for privacy).

resourceUri.description: The resource targeted by this action.

riskLevel.description: The assessed risk level of this action. Determined by the action taxonomy.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the action occurred.

AidaAttestationReceipt.description: Layer 3: An AIDA Attestation Receipt. A W3C Verifiable Credential recording an agent action, hash-linked to form a tamper-evident audit trail.

@context.description: W3C VC context. Must include the standard VC context and the AIDA attestation context.

type.description: W3C VC type. Must include 'VerifiableCredential' and 'AidaAttestationReceipt'.

issuer.description: The agent that performed the action and signed the receipt.

issuanceDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this receipt was created.

id.description: The agent that performed the action (same as issuer).

previousReceipt.description: SHA-256 hash of the previous receipt in the chain. Null for the first receipt in a session. Creates a tamper-evident hash chain.

sessionId.description: Identifier for the session this action belongs to.

grantId.description: The capability grant under which this action was authorized (if applicable).

proof.description: The agent's Ed25519 signature over the receipt. The verificationMethod is the agent's AidaUri.

AidaReceiptChain.description: A verified chain of attestation receipts. The chain is valid if every receipt's previousReceipt matches the hash of the preceding receipt, and all signatures verify.

verified.description: True if the entire chain has been cryptographically verified.

verificationErrors.description: If verified is false, describes which receipts failed verification and why.
